headlines.text: That Saturday in 2025, Mascara Dorada vs. Hechicero met in a Tournament Match, topping the bill that night on Collision, rated 7.70 ? a match that delivered.
On a Wednesday in 2023, back when AEW welcomed Lucha Brothers & Bandido for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.61 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.
That Friday in 2024, Viva Van competed under the AEW banner for the first time against Toni Storm, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.64.

secondaries.text: It was 2025 when Dante Martin chalked up their 100th recorded AEW match ? a real landmark moment, facing LFI (Dralistico, Mortos & Rush) vs. Top Flight & Fox on Collision, rated 6.76 in a fast-paced six-man clash.
On this day in 2025, Paragon & Ishii kicked off their AEW journey as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 7.03 ? a match that delivered.
Flash back to 2024, when Rey Fenix vs. Isiah Kassidy closed out Rampage, rated 6.95.
